name: The Punisher
description: Fan-made scenario pack by PermaKarma: The Punisher wages a one-man war on crime, and the minions in your way are his targets as much as yours.

permission.evidence: Granted by the author(s) in the Marvel Champions homebrew channel on Discord; confirmed by the project owner (Quin Carter) on 2026-11-13. The curated repository's record: https://github.com/bluefireF5ran/mc-digital-custom-packs/blob/a0c9f6000293115a9ecd58da347468ec875d52bb/punisher_pk/mod.json
permission.scope: inclusion and translation: the Spanish edition, hand-translated by BluefireF5ran, is covered (owner, 2026-11-13)
permission.note: 2026-11-13 is the date the owner confirmed the grant, not the date of the Discord message. The pack stays a DRAFT until the author confirms the curators' rules and wording fixes (Rachel Cole-Alves is their proposal).

translators.en: Francisco Merchán (rebuilt from the author's art)
